name: TikTok & Reels High-Retention UGC Hook
description: High-velocity vertical video framework engineered for thumb-stopping 0-3 second retention, dynamic camera zooms, and relatable peer-to-peer authenticity.

language.tone: Direct, conversational, high urgency, unfiltered honesty
language.guidelines: Begin with visceral hooks: 'Stop scrolling if...', 'I was gatekeeping this but...', 'Here is why everyone is wrong about...'

narrativeThemes: The Controversial Hot Take / Anti-Guru Debunk
The Embarrassing Before vs Flawless After Transformation
The Day-in-the-Life Chaos Turning into Satisfying Routine

visualStyling.lighting: Natural ring light glow, bathroom vanity mirror reflections, handheld natural daylight with dynamic shadows
visualStyling.colorPalette: Vibrant natural tones, clean warm whites, punchy pop accents
visualStyling.framing: 9:16 vertical framing, rapid camera punch-ins (1.3x zoom on punchline), quick tilt-downs to hands

branchingStructure.option1: The Shocking Pattern Interrupt (Starts with sensory sound or unexpected visual)
branchingStructure.option2: The Relatable Pain Point Callout (Addresses user frustration in first 2 seconds)
branchingStructure.option3: The Visual Transformation Hook (Starts at the climax result, then rewinds)
branchingStructure.optionR: Recalibrate (Explore an alternative viral hook archetype)

defaultTaglineFormat: Try it before it sells out completely.
